scope: Observed production browser latency. Different sequential rounds, not a replay of an identical saved state. Includes browser automation overhead. No billing or zero-cost guarantee.

finalObservation.note: The normal live match display then runs for its configured duration. This is not a claim that navigation was unlocked during the live match.
